pages.content:
{{article game navigation}} : ''{{Hatnote|You may also be looking for [[Rune (Historical)]], a retired feature of the game.}}'' [[File:Runes 2018.jpg|thumb|360px]]'''Runes''' are enhancements that add new abilities or buffs to the champion. The player can choose their loadout of runes before the match begins, during champion select, or their Collection tab. Runes Reforged (the current system of runes) was introduced in Pre-[[Season 2018]], supplanting the previous system of [[Runes (Historical)|Runes]] and [[Summoner Mastery|Masteries]], hence the name '''Reforged'''.[https://web.archive.org/web/0/http://na.leagueoflegends.com/en/featured/preseason-update Preseason Update][https://web.archive.org/web/0/https://na.leagueoflegends.com/en/news/game-updates/patch/patch-722-notes#patch-experience Patch 7.22 notes][https://web.archive.org/web/0/http://na.leagueoflegends.com/en/featured/preseason-update/8200-8230 Check out my build] == Rune Pages == [[File:Rune_pages_inventory.jpg|thumb|right|400px|Rune page inventory]] A player can have a maximum of 25 custom [[Rune Book|rune pages]], which are separate from the recommended rune page which cannot be edited and only exists per-game. Players in [[Experience (summoner)| levels 1 to 9]] cannot create nor edit rune pages. New accounts have two empty rune pages available; additional pages are purchased in the store for {{RP|590}} or {{BE|6300}} each. It is not possible to enter a match without an active, valid rune page. In such a case, the game will automatically assign the player with the recommended rune page for their champion and role, upon game start. {{clr}} === Rune Recommender === [[File:Rune recommender.png|thumb|right|350px|Rune recommender]] Hovering or locking in a champion in the Champion Selection screen allows you to access the Rune Recommender button on the left side of the loadout. The Rune Recommender automatically determines and recommends the best rune sets for your chosen champion and role, and presents up to three different sets. You can select a set in order to apply it to your loadout. * These recommended rune sets are updated per-patch based on current data and the best runes available for each champion in each role. * Optionally, the Rune Recommender can also recommend [[Summoner spell|summoner spell]] loadouts. The option can be enabled or disabled at will by clicking on the slider at the bottom of the Rune Recommender (this option persists through Champion Selection lobbies). {{clr}} == Rune paths == Runes are divided into five ''paths'': [[File:Rune icon.png|right|100px]] * [[File:Precision icon.png|20px|link=]] '''Precision''' - Improved attacks and sustained damage * [[File:Domination icon.png|20px|link=]] '''Domination''' - Burst damage and target access * [[File:Sorcery icon.png|20px|link=]] '''Sorcery''' - Empowered abilities and resource manipulation * [[File:Resolve icon.png|20px|link=]] '''Resolve''' - Durability and crowd control * [[File:Inspiration icon.png|20px|link=]] '''Inspiration''' - Creative tools and rule bending [[File:In-Game Runes.png|thumb|right|250px]] Each rune page contains runes from two paths: one primary and one secondary. The primary path has one keystone and three lesser runes. The secondary path has two lesser runes. There are also three ''Shard'' slots alongside the Primary and Secondary paths that follow a path separate from the five. Each individual slot can be filled with one selection. {{clr}} === Trees === {| border="0" cellpadding="1" cellspacing="1" class="article-table rune-table" width="100%" style="font-size:14px; text-align:center; background:transparent;" ! width="100px" style="text-align:center;" | Paths ! width="20%" style="text-align:center;" | Keystone ! width="20%" style="text-align:center;" | Slot 1 ! width="20%" style="text-align:center;" | Slot 2 ! width="20%" style="text-align:center;" | Slot 3 {{Rune table row|Precision}} {{Rune table row|Domination}} {{Rune table row|Sorcery}} {{Rune table row|Resolve}} {{Rune table row|Inspiration}} |} === Shards === {|class="article-table" width="100%" style="text-align:center;" ! !

pages.title: Slow resist
pages.content:
{{stil|Slow resist}}, also '''Slow resistance''', is a [[champion statistic|stat]] that reduces the strength of multiplicative (= percentage) {{tip|slow|slows}}. It affects percentage slows that are enemy-sourced and self-sourced (also called "''self-slows''" — e.g. {{ai|Overdrive|Blitzcrank}}, {{ai|Piercing Arrow|Varus}}'').

Slow resist is a percentage, and it indicates by how much the slow's percentage strength is reduced.

This is not to be confused with {{tip|tenacity}}, which affects the '''duration''' of slows.

* Slow resistance strictly {{tip|stacks multiplicatively}}.

== Increasing Slow Resist ==
Slow resist can be increased from [[Champion ability|abilities]], [[Buff|buffs]], [[Item (League of Legends)|items]], and [[Rune (League of Legends)|runes]].

=== Items ===
* {{ii|Boots of Swiftness}}
* {{ii|Dead Man's Plate}}
* {{ii|Swiftmarch}}

=== Champion abilities ===
* {{cai|Purge|Urgot}}
* {{cis|Shadow Assassin}} {{ai|Shadow Step A|Kayn|Shadow Step}} (equals total resistance)

=== Runes ===
* {{ri|Stormraider's Surge}}
* [[File:Rune shard Tenacity and Slow Resist.png|20px|link=Runes Reforged#Shards]] [[Runes Reforged#Shards|Tenacity and slow resist rune shard]]

=== Neutral buffs ===
* {{bi|Cloudbringer's Grace}}

== Slow Immunity ==
: {{tip|Slow-immune|'''Slow immunity'''}} is different from 100% slow resist as it ''prevents'' {{tip|slow|slows}} from being applied in the first place. It prevents the slow from {{tip|drowsy}} but does not prevent {{tip|sleep}}.

Note that if the ''slow'' has a ''cripple'' within the same status effect, such as {{ai|Wither|Nasus}}, {{tip|cleanse|cleanses}} that remove ''slows'' will also remove the accompanying ''cripple''.

=== Champion abilities ===
* {{cai|Sentry|Aphelios}}
* {{cai|H-28G Evolution Turret|Heimerdinger}}
* {{cai|Highlander|Master Yi}}
* {{cai|Biggest Snowball Ever!|Nunu}}
* {{cai|Fury of the North|Sejuani}}
* {{cai|Ixtal's Impact|Skarner}}

=== Statuses ===
* All effects that grant {{tip|Cc-immune|'''total''' crowd control immunity}} also prevent slows from being applied.

== Cripple Immunity ==
: {{tip|Cripple-immune|'''Cripple immunity'''}} prevents {{tip|cripple|cripples}} from being applied.

=== Champion abilities ===
* {{cai|Sentry|Aphelios}}
* {{cai|Highlander|Master Yi}}
* {{cai|Fury of the North|Sejuani}}
* {{cai|Jack in the Box|Shaco|boxes}}
* {{cai|Rampant Growth|Zyra|plants}}

=== Statuses ===
* All effects that grant {{tip|Cc-immune|'''total''' crowd control immunity}} also prevent cripples from being applied.

== Formulas ==
These formulas can calculate how much slow resist you have, based on your movement speed and on the slow applied to you.
;Formula 1
<math>Movement\ Speed \leq 220:
</math>
<math>Slow Resist = 1 - ({{1 - {{FinalMS - 110} \over {(BaseMS + BonusMS) \times (1 + MS Multiplier) \times 0.5}}}) \div {Slow}}
</math>

;Formula 2

<math>
220 \leq Movement\ Speed \leq 415:
</math>
<math>
Slow Resist = 1 - ({{1 - {{FinalMS} \over {(BaseMS + BonusMS) \times (1 + MS Multiplier)}}}) \div {Slow}}
</math>

;Formula 3

<math>
415 \leq Movement\ Speed \leq 490:
</math>
<math>
Slow Resist = 1 - ({{1 - {{{{FinalMS - 475} \over {0.5}} + 490} \over {(BaseMS + BonusMS) \times (1 + MS Multiplier)}}}) \div {Slow}}
</math>

;Formula 4
<math>
Movement\ Speed \geq 490:
</math>
<math>
Slow Resist = 1 - ({{1 - {{{{FinalMS - 415} \over {0.8}} + 415} \over {(BaseMS + BonusMS) \times (1 + MS Multiplier)}}}) \div {Slow}}
</math>

=== Glossary ===
* '''Slow Resist''' is the amount of slow resist you currently have.
* '''Final MS''' is your movement speed after being slowed, already considering your slow resist.
* '''BaseMS''' is your base movement speed.
* '''BonusMS''' is the sum of all additive flat movement speed bonuses.
* '''MS Multiplier''' is the sum of all additive percent movement speed bonuses.
* '''Slow''' is the strongest slow currently applied on your champion.
* '''Slow Resist''', '''MS Multiplier''', and '''Slow''' are percentages (e.g. 50% is {{fd|0.5}} in the formula).

== Notes ==
* '''Slow resist''' will also reduce the strength of currently-applied slows on the user, if the stat is gained while afflicted.
* '''Slow resist''' does not affect abilities that reduce the target's movement speed by / to a ''flat'' amount (e.g. {{ai|Jack in the Box|Shaco}}, {{ai|Shield of Durand|Galio}}, {{ai|Whimsy|Lulu}}).
* '''Slow resist''' does not apply to negative bonus movement speed ({{ai|R|Samira}} and {{ai|Q|Renata Glasc}}).
* {{ui|Rift Scuttler}} gains 100% slow resist while not fleeing.
* If a champion with {{ii|Boots of Swiftness}} and 400 movement speed is affected by a 40% {{tip|slow}}, they will have that slow decreased to 30%.
** Base reduction of a 40% {{tip|slow}}: 400{{times}}(1{{minus}}{{fd|0.4}}){{equals}}240, for a total reduction of 160 movement speed.
** Reduction of a 40% {{tip|slow}} with 25% slow resist: 400{{times}}(1{{minus}}({{fd|0.4}}{{times}}{{fd|0.75}})){{equals}}280, for a total reduction of 120 movement speed.
----

pages.title: Tenacity
pages.content:
{{sti|'''Tenacity'''}}, or '''Crowd Control Reduction''', is a [[Champion statistic|stat]] that reduces the duration of all incoming {{tip|crowd control}} status effects (''disables'') except {{tip|airborne}}, {{tip|drowsy}}, {{tip|nearsight}}, {{tip|stasis}}, and {{tip|suppression}}.

Tenacity is a percentage, and it indicates by how much the disable's duration is reduced. Any disable's duration cannot be reduced below {{fd|0.3}} seconds{{tt|*|Not accounting for cleanup delay 'fuzziness' and some other details regarding ticks and updates, which increase the actual duration again}}. The disable's duration is calculated at the moment of application, and does '''not''' change during it if '''tenacity''' changes.

* Tenacity [[stacking|stacks]] either {{tip|stacks multiplicatively|multiplicatively}} or {{tip|stacks additively|additively}}, depending on the combination of the effects.

Tenacity can be increased (self- or ally-sourced) and decreased (enemy-sourced) from {{tip|abilities}}, {{tip|buffs}}, [[Item (League of Legends)|items]], [[Rune (League of Legends)|runes]], and [[Summoner spell|summoner spells]].

{{gold value}}
* '''Tenacity''' has a gold value of {{g|{{#invoke:Gold value|wikivaluedefine}}{{#var:tenacity}}}} per point, for more details see [[Gold efficiency (League of Legends)#Secondary stat reference items|this page]].

== Increasing tenacity ==
=== Items ===
{{Item stat table|tenacity}}
==== Item actives and passives ====
* {{ii|Elixir of Iron}}
* {{ii|Protoplasm Harness}}

=== Champion abilities ===
* {{cai|Courage|Garen}}
* {{cai|Breath of Life|Milio}}

=== Runes ===

* [[File:Rune shard Tenacity and Slow Resist.png|20px|link=Rune#Shards]] [[Rune#Shards|Tenacity and slow resist rune shard]]

=== Summoner Spells ===

=== Game Modes ===
* {{tip|ARAM}} (Champion-specific)
* {{tip|Ultra Rapid Fire}}
* {{tip|Ultimate Spellbook}}

== Decreasing tenacity ==
Note that '''tenacity''' can have negative values, which will cause incoming disables to last longer.

=== Champion Abilities ===
* {{cai|Bellows Breath|Ornn}} and {{ai|Call of the Forge God|Ornn}} apply {{tip|Brittle}}, a unique status effect that reduces targets' tenacity by 30%.

<!--
Needs to be updated
=== Monsters ===
* {{ui|Rift Scuttler}} has -100% tenacity, doubling the duration of crowd control effects applied to her. This stacks additively with {{tip|Brittle}} for a total of -130% tenacity.
-->

== Stacking ==
The '''tenacity''' stat is built up from sub-stats that internally are referred to as "modifiers" and are part of three different groups, labelled A, B, or C. Modifiers within the same group stack '''multiplicatively''', while the different groups stack '''additively''' with each other.

'''Tenacity''' is capped at 100%.

The mathematics regarding the '''total''' tenacity is as follows:

''(1 - ((1 - A1)(1 - A2)(1 - ...))) + (1 - ((1 - B1)(1 - B2)(1 - ...))) + (1 - ((1 - C1)(1 - C2)(1 - ...)))''

{| class="article-table"
! 
! style="text-align:center;" | Source
|-
! Group A
|
* {{ii|Elixir of Iron}}
* {{ii|Mercury's Treads}}
* {{ii|Protoplasm Harness}}
* {{ii|Sterak's Gage}}
* {{ii|Wit's End}}
* {{Item icon|Endless Hunger}}
* [[File:Rune shard Tenacity and Slow Resist.png|20px|link=Rune#Shards]] [[Runes#Shards|Tenacity and slow resist rune shard]]
* {{bi|Chemtech Blight}}
|-
! Group B
| 
* {{cai|Breath of Life|Milio}}
* {{si|Cleanse}}
* Map/mode-specific adjustments such as for {{tip|ARAM}}, {{tip|Ultimate Spellbook}}, {{tip|Ultra Rapid Fire}}, etc.
|-
! Group C
| 
* {{cai|Courage|Garen}}
* {{tip|Brittle}}
* {{uis|Rift Scuttler}} innate negative tenacity
|}

For instance, a champion has {{ii|Mercury's Treads}} and {{ii|Wit's End}} equipped, and they have been debuffed by {{tip|Brittle|Brittle's}} tenacity reduction from an enemy. The sum of their '''tenacity''' is calculated as follows:
* '''Group A''' Tenacity modifiers = {{ii|Mercury's Treads|30%}}{{times}}{{ii|Wit's End|20%}}
* '''Group C''' Tenacity modifier = {{tip|Brittle|-30%}}
* '''Final''' Tenacity = (1 - ((1 - {{ii|Mercury's Treads|icononly = true}}){{times}}(1 - {{ii|Wit's End|icononly = true}})) Group A Tenacity modifiers + {{tip|Brittle|icononly=true}} Group C Tenacity modifier
* = (1 - ((1 - {{ii|Mercury's Treads|{{fd|0.3}}}}){{times}}(1 - {{ii|Wit's End|{{fd|0.2}}}})) + {{tip|Brittle|-0.3}}
* = (1 - ({{fd|0.7}}{{times}}{{fd|0.8}})) + {{fd|-0.3}}
* = {{fd|0.44}} + {{fd|-0.3}} = '''14%'''

== Trivia ==
* Until patch [[V1.0.0.118]], '''Tenacity''' was an unnamed effect unique to {{ii|Mercury's Treads}}. That patch promoted the effect to a [[champion statistic]] and added three new items: {{ii|Cloak and Dagger}}, {{ii|Eleisa's Miracle}} and {{ii|Moonflair Spellblade}} (all later removed). '''Tenacity''' from multiple sources did not stack, similar to {{nie|Enhanced Movement}}. In [[Season Three|Season Three (2013)]] there was an item overhaul, named item effects were introduced, and '''Tenacity''' was reverted to an item effect. In [[V3.01]], all sources of crowd control reduction were changed to say "Tenacity" and '''Tenacity''' was reintroduced as a champion statistic.
* Until [[Season Three|Season Three (2013)]], '''Tenacity's''' in-game icon was the same as the icon used for {{cai|Vorpal Spikes|Cho'Gath}} and {{uis|Baron Nashor}} passive. Between the introduction of season 3 changes and [[V3.01]], it shared the same icon as the {{mi3|Tenacious}} mastery. As of [[V3.01]], it no longer has an icon in the buff bar.
* Prior to the Preseason of 2021, a [https://na.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/news/riot-games/preseason-2021-champion-class-item-goals/ website news post] was made that announced that Tenacity would reduce the duration of {{tip|airborne|knockups}}. However, the change was confirmed to have been cancelled.<ref>[https://twitter.com/MarkYetter/status/1317905623657246721 Twitter post by Mark Yetter on Tenacity change]</ref>
* Prior to his VGU in patch [[V11.12]], {{cis|Dr. Mundo|variant = old2}} {{ai|Burning Agony|Dr. Mundo}} granted himself 30% '''Tenacity''' which was additive with other "Champion Tenacity" buffs such as {{tip|Brittle}}.
* Prior to [[V3.04]], {{cai|Insanity Potion|Singed}} granted himself {{ap|10|15|20}}% '''Tenacity'''<!-- this probably stacked additively with other "Champion Tenacity" buffs, at least in theory, but this is lacking evidence-->.
* Prior to patch [[V12.22]], {{iis|Sunfire Aegis}} Mythic passive granted 5% '''Tenacity''' per Legendary item which was additive with other "Buff Tenacity" buffs such as {{ii|Elixir of Iron}} and {{ri|Unflinching}}.
* On patch [[V12.22]] it became possible to reach 100% tenacity by combining {{ii|Mercury's Treads}} (30%) {{ii|Silvermere Dawn}} (active) (50%) and {{ii|Iceborn Gauntlet}} with 4 other legendary items (20%), which are additive with one another. Until [[V12.23]] it was even possible to reach 120% Tenacity by including {{ii|Mosstomper Seedling}}, which was also additive with these sources.
* After [[V13.3]], the highest amount of tenacity was changed to 100% since combinations of effects in different groups were made to be additive.
** Examples of combinations that can reach the cap:
*** {{ai|Courage|Garen}} and {{si|Cleanse}} [60% + 75% = <u>135%</u>]
*** {{ai|Courage|Garen}}, {{ii|Mercury's Treads}} and {{ii|Sterak's Gage}} [60% + (100% - 70% * 80%) = <u>104%</u>]
*** {{si|Cleanse}}, {{ii|Mercury's Treads}} and {{ii|Sterak's Gage}} [75% + (100% - 70% * 80%) = <u>119%</u>]
*** {{ii|Mercury's Treads}}, {{ai|Breath of Life|Milio}} and {{si|Cleanse}} [30% + (100% - 35% * 25%) = <u>121,25%</u>]
